units: B. Mets. 59ᵃ all gates are sometimes closed except the gates (of prayer) of those wronged by men (v. אוֹנָאָה), for it says, (Amos VII, 3) “Behold the Lord stands on the wall of anakh and in his hand he holds anakh (oppression).” Ib. אונאה דכתיב ובידו א׳ the Lord hears the prayer of the wronged, for it says &c.; v. אוֹנָיָתָא.
